title: fix(circular): keep the helix entries of the rings apart
body:
## What changed

- A flat Circular with a helix entry turns the start of each later ring. The new start is a vertex of the ring's own polygon. At that vertex, the predicted helix orbit keeps 0.01 mm from the orbits that the earlier rings flew.
- After each ring, the kernel reads the descents that the ring flew. It uses the crossing law itself (`verify::crossed_pairs`, 0.01 mm and 0.001 mm chords). If a descent crosses a descent of an earlier ring, the operation is refused by name: `helix entry: the descent at ... crosses the descent of an earlier ring ...`.
- The first ring and each ring without a conflict keep vertex 0. Plunge entry, ramp entry and the vault mode do not change.
- The new logic is in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/circular_helix.rs`.
- The test module of `circular.rs` moved to `circular_tests.rs` (the `#[path]` pattern). `circular.rs` was 411 lines. It is now 374 lines.

## Cause

All rings of a flat Circular run the same level ladder. Thus the helix of each ring shares each level's depth band with the helix of each other ring. The descent puts each helix next to the ring start, and all rings started at the +X vertex. With stepover 2 and helix radius 1, the helices touched. The crossing law reported each pair, and verification blocked the post.

## Tests

New pins in `crates/motion/tests/circular_helix_rings.rs`:

- `a_multi_ring_helix_circular_has_no_crossing`: the issue's job (R10, Ø6, stepover 2, helix 1) and four more sizes, climb and conventional, at two centers. No crossing pair. Red before the fix (`feed moves 2 and 83 cross ...`, 22 pairs).
- `the_issue_job_verifies_without_crossings`: full `verify` on the issue's job. No warning except `RapidInStock`. Red before the fix (Crossing).
- `a_helix_that_cannot_stand_apart_is_refused_by_name`: helix radius 3 on a Ø6 cutter in R10 is refused by name. Other sizes generate with no crossing, or are refused by name. Red before the fix (it generated with crossings).
- `every_ring_still_reaches_the_floor`: each ring still cuts its full circle at the floor.

Unit tests: `circular_helix::tests` (halving order, orbit test, the reading) and `a_phase_turns_the_ring_start_only`.

Mutations:

- Stagger off (phase always 0): the three generation pins go red, because the reading refuses the job.
- Refusal off: `a_helix_that_cannot_stand_apart_is_refused_by_name` goes red.
- The upstream `circular.rs`: three pins go red.
